entries.leaseHolderLiveness: LEASEORPHAN-01: rescue reconciles unresolved TERM receipts after group drain through AR exact-key pre-receipt recovery. Admitted launches bind lrqId; confirmed dead unlaunched owners release with audit. lease-left requires positive live ownership; unavailable evidence reports reconciliation-required. Both lease types share host/PID/start-time liveness; same-host unknown evidence retains custody. Confirmed-merged terminal controllers release lane and closer leases and audit before scratch cleanup without a PR-bound dispatch or decision. After both PRs deploy and AR floats, SRE restarts watcher/follow-up, verifies PID start times and observes 24 hours: no dead-submitter lease-left, no dead same-host unlaunched lease beyond one watcher pass, no merged-PR closeout decision. Plan: modules/worker-pool/post-merge-actions/LEASEORPHAN-01.yaml. Existing merge predicates, custody, attestations and strict mode stay mandatory; no new automated smoke command.
entries.recordedLaunchCustody: CLOSERCUSTODYLRQ-01: durable dispatch receipts and optional lease workerId/dispatchedAt retain launch custody across restart. Before replacement intent publication, probe the recorded launch including retries; terminal evidence permits host teardown with `--force` to bypass the open-PR guard while host custody checks remain mandatory, live/parked owners retain custody, and unavailable evidence retains the receipt and bounded wait/page. Legacy public slot fallback and existing attempt/ceiling/merge gates remain. Activate by watcher restart after deploy; SRE observes a natural failed/succeeded launch release within one tick with launch ID/status/reason and the next budgeted dispatch. Synthetic tests only; no new smoke command.
entries.ciCapacityRecovery: CIBLOCKRESUME-01: exact-head infrastructure recovery retires matching legacy decision-blocked local custody under the intent lock and lease CAS; recoveredLaunchRequestId retains provenance. Live/unknown retries and merge gates remain enforced.
entries.suspendedCloserResume: GSR-07: re-adopt resumed leases or rebind a successor and source-owned dispatch record across all retained heads. Release as superseded only after launchRequestOwned proves no PR ownership, including retries; parked/live/unknown evidence retains the lease. CAS collisions report aggregate busy if nothing changed. Release CLI prepares the authenticated session before synchronous ledger reads; bootstrap failure preserves leases.
entries.retryableMergeRelease: HAMLANEWAIT-02: retryable merge deferrals release closer ownership as terminal with retryable-<reason> (lane-busy, merge-lease-timeout, required-checks-pending, pr-mergeability-unknown). The audit CLI writes the receipt under the existing owner snapshot fence. In-run lease retries retain ownership. Closure/rescue and bounded startup/periodic sweeps reconcile terminal launches before admission; live launches, retries, parked owners and unreadable evidence retain their existing semantics. Ordinary same-head daemon eligibility or hammer admission schedules the retry through existing backoff, attempt and lifetime caps; terminal lease reclamation and exclusive acquisition prevent duplicate retries. Orphan ownership probes a dispatched lease LRQ even without its dispatch projection. No new lifecycle states, config keys, checks or smoke actions; deployment acceptance requires natural recovery observation. VERIFYHEADTRANSIENT-01: terminalOutcome also accepts retryable-<reason> for all explicit infrastructure read reasons in HAMMER_RETRYABLE_READ_OUTCOMES in src/ama/hammer-phase-outcome.mjs (25 at introduction); the allowlist is authoritative, never free text. Terminal fallback preserves the resolved retryable receipt. Red checks, conflicts, moved heads, cancellation and proven owner loss retain final accounting.
entries.pendingAbandonment: CLOSERLEASEDEAD-01: pending without lrqId records terminal abandoned-holder-dead for a confirmed absent/reused same-host PID, or foreign-host abandoned-timeout strictly after acquiredAt + dispatchTimeoutMs. Current-process ownership remains. Intent lock and expected-lease CAS preserve unresolved submissions and replacements. Startup logs releases; closure recomputes next action including after uncertain yielded probes. Terminal outcomes are reclaimed by ordinary dispatch. DEADWATCHERLEASE-01: optional watcherStartedAt binds local pending ownership to the exact process start identity; mismatch proves PID reuse, including before acquisition. Confirmed live local owners retain custody past expiry. Existing startup sweep runs once before periodic polling; fenced abandonment emits ama_closer.abandoned_lease_reclaimed with owner PID/start identity and permits ordinary same-pass terminal reclamation and acquisition. Unknown submissions remain fenced for receipt/absence proof.
entries.preReceiptReaper: PRERECEIPTADOPT-01: a unique own-key closer receipt may have a null/empty ticket with matching optional repo/head; terminal recovery invokes shared retry/merge-aware settlement before watcher admission, also available through audited operator recovery. LAC-2081: unresolved dispatching intents preserve leases and retry budget; native proof owns settlement; lease mutations share reclaim flock and compare expected owner
entries.parkedOwnership: LRQSTATUS-01: a matching terminal deferred lease continues to fence redispatch and inline daemon merge through resumed execution, including rekeyed heads; only confirmed terminal launch/retry evidence releases ownership
entries.reconciliation: Terminal no-merge launch on a confirmed live OPEN same head is reclaimable after the readable 60-second terminal grace (immediate without a timestamp), with armed auto-merge held only inside the fixed 30-minute dispatched-lease window unless a no-merge audit resolves it; merged success stays sticky. TERMLEASE-01 reclaims terminal superseded/failed-without-merge/deferred on the same pass with proven ended/absent launch; live or unproven launches hold. Superseded dispatches release matching rekeyed leases and retain the dispatch outcome.

entries.processIdentityCompatibility: DEADWATCHERLEASE-01 final remediation: acquisition captures only positive integer local PIDs and tolerates capture failures with null watcherStartedAt; invalid or missing watcherPid persists as null. Conditional deletion/restoration equates missing/null start identity but rejects different identities; full-snapshot expectedLease updates stay exact. The legacy reaper age selector checks shared start identity before retaining a live PID; verified reuse permits age fallback, matching/unreadable identity retains live custody.
